svg.title: delta-taxonomy
svg.desc: Ten transition matrices A_t drawn as toy 6×6 heat maps (teal positive, red negative), with the models that use them, their eigenvalues and their chunk algorithm: identity (linear attention), fixed γI (RetNet, Lightning), α_t I (Mamba-2, mLSTM), Diag(α_t) (GLA, HGRN2), I − βkkᵀ (DeltaNet), α(I − βkkᵀ) (Gated DeltaNet), Diag(α)(I − βkkᵀ) (KDA), Diag(w) − κ̂(a⊙κ̂)ᵀ (RWKV-7, Comba), a product of Householders (DeltaProduct), and α times a rotation (Mamba-3). All keep the same d_v×d_k state.
